definitions.gloss: large sum of money; high price; expensive
definitions.explanation: An amount of money that is notably large. Often used as a no-adjective ({高額|こうがく}の/{高額|こうがく}な) to modify nouns, describing things that cost or are worth a lot.

examples.japanese: {高額|こうがく}な⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{高額|こうがく}{医療費|いりょうひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{払|はら}い{戻|もど}し→払い戻す：16528_haraimodosu⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}した→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I used the high-cost medical expense reimbursement system.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{高額|こうがく}だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{利便性|りべんせい}→利便性：10681_ribensei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{妥当|だとう}→妥当：04053_datou⟧な⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: This apartment is expensive because it's close to the station, but I think the price is reasonable considering the convenience.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧ (high) + ⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧ (amount). Functions as both a noun and a no-/na-adjective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高額|こうがく}な⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧ (expensive product)
- {高額|こうがく}{医療費|いりょうひ} (high medical expenses)
- {高額|こうがく}{納税者|のうぜいしゃ} (high taxpayer)
- {高額|こうがく}⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧ (winning a large amount, as in lottery)
- {高額|こうがく}⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧ (large bill/charge)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{高価|こうか}→高価：02796_kouka⟧ (expensive, costly) describes the value or quality of goods, while {高額|こうがく} focuses on the monetary amount. ⟦{高値|たかね}→高値：14703_takane⟧ refers specifically to market prices.
